scope.question: does limiter learning move clean N when the capturer is the functioning scripted clean-fire launcher
scope.fire_rule: scripted clean-crossing proposal; FSM gate decides; no external forced fire in training or evaluation
scope.log_prob_rule: scripted capturer actions never enter any policy log-prob; finisher actor frozen (no_grad, loss coefficient 0)

learned_limiter.limiter: learned (MAPPO), final mean layer zeroed at t=0, stochastic exploration retained, no commit head

training.sampler: identical 70/20/10 row schedule as the pilot (scheduled_cell), new jitter namespace

hyperparameters.note: pilot ended NO_SELECTION, so no candidate is blessed; these are pre-declared defaults (= c0_base values), not winners

evaluation.policy: stochastic with per-episode fixed torch seed; scripted arms consume no torch randomness
evaluation.paired: all three arms consume the identical (cell, sid, chi, eta) stream and episode seeds

readout.rule: descriptive only, pre-registered: per-arm counts of N/FIRE/crossing/H_illegal, and per-cell paired delta(N) sign counts for learned-vs-hold and learned-vs-c5, per seed
readout.promotion: none; regardless of outcome this does not open W6
readout.stop: budget exhaustion; abort on NaN/Inf training stats
